label: Late in episode, D1 rises after reward/a1; GO rises after S1, falls after reward; S1 belief raises it.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward + (prev_action==1)) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == GO) * ((prev_state==S1) - prev_reward) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/20)
terms: (phase == D1) * prev_reward * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action==1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == GO) * prev_reward * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state==S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D2) * (state==S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase == D2) * prev_reward * np.exp(ep_trial/20) ;; (phase==D2)*(action==1)*np.exp(ep_trial/20)
explanation: Raw candidate n33 sits near +1 early in the episode and falls sharply late in the episode (timing explains R^2 0.83). Its history effects grow roughly exponentially with episode trial (exp(ep_trial/20) scaling beats linear ep_trial: 0.31 vs 0.25 dev). At D1 it is higher after a rewarded previous trial and after a1, lowest after unrewarded a2 trials. At GO the reward sign flips: higher when the previous trial reached S1 and lower after reward (most negative after S2 rewarded). Across phases it rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good. The free fit adds separate D1/GO weights and D2 terms (state reached S1, choice a1, previous reward), reaching 0.36 dev vs 0.31 for the short form. Future variables are not needed. The largest misses are the last ~10 trials, where the unit goes strongly negative after unrewarded a2 trials, which the model underpredicts.
